text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's phenomenal running 
overwhelmed the crowd. Her performance 
seemed to ignite a fierce fighting spirit 
within Hishi Amazon, watching from the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian sought even greater strength. 
Her Trainer recommended the Classic Triple 
Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Competing against strong rivals will make 
her even stronger. Narita Brian and her 
Trainer decide to set their sights on the 
Satsuki Sho first.
